items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh yeah, he introduced me to Fats.

ctx.x: Did you meet Fats Waller at all?

Oh yeah, he introduced me to Fats. That was his idol, Fats Waller. He told me how he got the job, he was stranded in Kansas City and Fats Waller was playing at a theatre there called the Eblon Theatre playing the organ and then Fats got this call to come to California to make a movie. And he asked Basie did he want the job. And Basie said, “I don’t know how to play the organ, I’ve never played an organ.” Fats took him to the theatre, showed him how to play the organ and Basie got the job. Fats and Basie were very…
